Class Shield

java.lang.Object
model.items.concrete.Shield
All Implemented Interfaces:
Equipable, Item
public class Shield extends Object implements Equipable
Represents a Shield that can be equipped by a PlayerCharacter.

Equipping the shield increases the player's defense by a fixed amount. Unequipping the shield removes the bonus defense.
